hero.description: I've been building software and leading teams for ten years. CTO at Akieni. Before that, I co-founded Cowema.
about.label: ABOUT
about.heading: Teams, and systems that stay up
about.description_1: I joined Akieni as the first engineer on site. We grew to 18 engineers, then a division of 20. Before that I co-founded Cowema and ran the technology for three years, past 40,000 users.
about.description_2: Three national platforms are live: tax, health insurance, and social security. I also handle payments and identity on a public program. On the side I run Akieni Academy, from 30 to 200 learners. 60% of graduates have a job.
about.description_3: I still review designs and pull requests, and I code in Laravel, Python, TypeScript and C#. Building a team, or something technical is stuck? Write to me.

services.label: SERVICES
services.heading: How I can help
services.description: I advise, and I code when something has to ship.
services.technical_strategy.title: Technical strategy
services.technical_strategy.subtitle: Architecture
services.technical_strategy.description: Monolith or microservices, a new stack, a migration: I help you pick what will work for you. I've done this for government agencies, a marketplace past 40,000 users, and enterprise platforms.
services.engineering_leadership.title: Engineering management
services.engineering_leadership.subtitle: Growing a team
services.engineering_leadership.descript: At Akieni we grew from 7 to 18 engineers. At Cowema I took juniors to senior. Useful if you're hiring your first team, or if you've passed ten people and the organization can't keep up.
services.system_design.title: Architecture and migration
services.system_design.subtitle: Start from what runs
services.system_design.description: When you modernize an application or plan a migration, I start from what already runs. I've split monoliths. I've also left them alone, when splitting them didn't help.
services.fullstack_development.title: Interim CTO
services.fullstack_development.subtitle: With the team
services.fullstack_development.descripti: I can be the CTO or VP for a while: hire, set a pace for shipping, and get out what's stuck. I don't only do slides.
services.technical_consulting.title: Technical advice
services.technical_consulting.subtitle: Straight advice
services.technical_consulting.descriptio: When a technical decision isn't moving, I review the architecture, read the code, and help pick the tool. I rely on systems I've already built.
